modelling_rules: Use real dimensioned axle intervals and wheel diameters as independent chassis constraints.
Track gauge, wheel back-to-back and rendered wheel-center separation are different quantities.
Do not compensate for body silhouette problems by changing verified axle intervals.
Do not derive missing dimensions from Sketchfab mesh, screenshots, low-resolution line spacing or printed image proportions.
When projecting to metres, divide millimetres by 1000 exactly.
Keep source-specific, museum-specific and provisional parameters visibly separated.
